title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 8 and 16; step "worked"; peak-window rectangle with fillOpacity={0.16}
findings.title: Peak-window boundaries are too low-contrast
findings.problem: The borderless amber shading has approximately 1.12:1 contrast against the light plot background and 1.35:1 against the dark background. Low-vision students cannot reliably distinguish the highlighted interval's boundaries. The readable clock-time label does not fix the chart highlight itself.
findings.fix: Draw opaque, high-contrast boundary lines or an outline above the curve fills, using an appropriate token such as C.accent. Retain the clock-time label and verify boundary contrast in both themes, including where the shading overlaps the curve area.

assessment: Needs revision: the worked-example peak-window highlight has insufficient contrast.
